build: npm run ux:build on wf10/ux at HEAD 5469d40 with the wave-2 packages (w2-sync, w2-session, w2-render, w2-perf) and integration-2 in the working tree (web/test-results/ux-review/_dist, built 2026-10-05 16:55, no source file newer than it), served by vite preview on ports 4770 to 4789, one port per concurrent run; Playwright output under web/test-results/ux-review/_pw/verify2/
summary: 30 entries checked (28 distinct ids): the 10 wave-2 items (VER-01, VER-02, UX-017a, UX-012a, the pasted-JSON wording, UX-023, the OptionGroup print border, UX-100 and the two dev-merge checks, the self-test page and the RT block) and the 20 major wave-1 items replayed on desktop WebKit and on the Pixel 7 project, which wave 1 had not covered (UX-012a and UX-017a are in both lists and have an entry in each). All 30 verified, 0 partially, 0 not fixed, 0 regressed. Every wave-2 scenario was replayed from the fix notes and the source findings on Chromium and the iPhone 13 project, plus WebKit desktop and Pixel 7 where the item needed them, at 320x568 and 200% text where the finding named them; evidence under web/test-results/ux-review/verify2/<item>/<project>/ with NNN-facts.json. The regression sweep toured all 51 product routes with metrics and axe on Chromium at 390 and 1280 px in light and dark (204 states), on iPhone 13 at 390 px light and dark (102 states) and on desktop WebKit at 1280 px light (51 states): every route opened, no sideways overflow, no clipped text, no serious or critical axe issue, no console or page error beyond the expected WebGL message on the no-WebGL route, and no new small target against the wave-1 verify tours (web/test-results/ux-review/verify2/tour-compare.json: new 0 on each project). One whole ?fast=1 session per project (Chromium 135 answers, iPhone 205, WebKit 196) ended in a profile, downloaded a valid save, came back through a reload to the ready screen with the 'Last saved today at …' line, loaded the file, and 'See my results' showed the same blob marks and bar-view rows. One new finding, VER2-01 (minor, desktop WebKit only): inside an option group the orange focus ring leaves the card as soon as an arrow key moves the focus, because WebKit stops matching :focus-visible there; only the chosen ring remains. Wave-1 coverage gaps closed: desktop WebKit, Pixel 7 and the autosave line.
